articles.title: Identifying FortiGate Firmware From a Single ClientHello
articles.snippet: About 376,000 internet-facing FortiGate hosts expose their FGFM management port and answer a connection with a TLS ClientHello. A JA4 fingerprint of that ClientHello places each host in a FortiOS generation, which maps to a range of versions and the CVEs that affect them. 160,171 hosts (42.6%) are in generations where every version we measured has a known-exploited CVE.
